traits.name: Sanguinario
traits.description: +Violencia, fear; raises calentura; others trust them less.

traits.name: Calculador
traits.description: +Astucia; better schemes; slow to commit forces.

traits.name: Ambicioso
traits.description: Pushes for promotion and territory; likely to scheme against superiors.

traits.name: Paranoico
traits.description: Hard to scheme against; may purge their own people.

traits.name: Carismático
traits.description: +Palabra; crews under them hold morale longer.

traits.name: Impulsivo
traits.description: Attacks early and alone; strong ambushes, weak sieges.

traits.name: Discreto
traits.description: Low profile growth; crews move with lower signature.

traits.name: Valiente
traits.description: Crews hold under fire; leader death risk is higher.
